defs.def: an electronic machine that can store, organize and find information, do calculations and control other machines 计算机；电脑

ex.s: SLEAP uses computer vision (the ability for computers to understand images) and deep learning (an AI approach for training a computer to learn and work like the human brain) to help researchers process images much more quickly.
ex.t: SLEAP使用计算机视觉（计算机理解图像的能力）和深度学习（一种训练计算机像人脑一样学习和工作的AI方法），帮助研究者更快地处理图像。

ex.s: Computer programming is a must for scientists.
ex.t: 计算机编程对科学家来说是必备技能。

ex.s: They could have written pages on the necessity of computers, but writing, in and of itself, simply didn’t strike them as important.
ex.t: 他冲出希尔家，快速穿过街道。

ex.s: One day, during a class in the IT lab with my classmates, our teacher mentioned missing computer parts. ____2____ looks exchanged, everyone wondered how it could happen in a(n) ____3____ lab.
ex.t: 一天，在IT实验室和同学上课时，老师提到少了电脑零件。___2___交换了一下眼神，大家都想知道这怎么会发生在一个___3___的实验室里。

ex.s: ·Science Lab: Leading you to explore the skills you need to succeed in life in key areas like computer science, robotics, and physics
ex.t: 这些缺陷无疑会被解决，但它们也指向一个根本性问题。

ex.s: Eating alone, especially in front of the TV or computer, often leads to mindless overeating.
ex.t: 独自进食，尤其是在电视或电脑前，往往导致无意识的暴饮暴食。

ex.s: So, if we accept that the universe is unknowable, we also accept we will never know if we live in a computer simulation.
ex.t: 所以，如果我们接受宇宙是不可知的，我们也接受我们永远无法知道是否生活在一个计算机模拟中。

ex.s: And then, we can shift our inquiry from “Is the universe a computer simulation? ” to “Can we model the universe as a computer simulation? ” Modelling reality is what we do.
ex.t: 然后，我们可以将我们的探究从"宇宙是一个计算机模拟吗？"转移到"我们能否将宇宙建模为一个计算机模拟？"建模现实正是我们所做的事。

ex.s: Now that we are in the information age, we have new concepts such as the computer, information processing, virtual reality, and simulation.
ex.t: 既然我们处于信息时代，我们就有了计算机、信息处理、虚拟现实和模拟等新概念。

ex.s: It can be imagined that comparable to the process of building previous scientific models, developing the “computer simulation” metaphor-based model will also be a hugely rewarding exercise.
ex.t: 可以想象，与构建以往科学模型的过程类似，发展这种基于"计算机模拟"隐喻的模型也将是一项极具价值的实践。

ex.s: As Kristian Hammond, professor of electrical engineering and computer science at Northwestern University, put it: “There’s never a stage at which the system knows what it’s talking about.”
ex.t: 正如西北大学电气工程与计算机科学教授克里斯蒂安·哈蒙德所言：系统从来没有一个阶段知道自己到底在说什么。

ex.s: A computer works with symbols.
ex.t: 计算机用符号工作。

ex.s: Indeed, to a computer, meaning is irrelevant.
ex.t: 的确，对计算机而言，意义是无关的。

ex.s: Recently, scientists have started a debate on _______the computers will “think” like human in half a century.
ex.t: 最近，科学家们就____计算机在半个世纪后是否会像人类一样“思考”展开了辩论。

ex.s: Using the computer.
ex.t: 使用电脑。

ex.s: His father frequently amused the boy with a tablet computer which was loaded with colorful pictures that come alive when you poke them.
ex.t: 他父亲常用平板电脑逗他开心，那上面装载着五彩缤纷、戳一下就会动起来的图片。

ex.s: He took it for a tablet computer.
ex.t: 他把它当成了平板电脑。

ex.s: “People from cultures that value relationships more than ours does are shocked by the thought of eating alone in front of a computer”, says Art Markman, a professor of psychology at the University of Texas, Austin.
ex.t: 来自比我们更看重关系的文化的人们，一想到在电脑前独自吃饭就会震惊，得克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校心理学教授阿特·马克曼说。

ex.s: A friend has been sending me articles on how quantum computers might help solve some of the biggest challenges we face as humans.
ex.t: 一位朋友一直给我发文章，讲量子计算机如何帮助解决人类面临的一些最大挑战。

ex.s: One is computer scientist Chris Johnson who I see as someone who helps keep the field honest The other is physicist Philip Taylor.
ex.t: 一位是计算机科学家Chris Johnson，我认为他是一个有助于保持该领域诚实的人。另一位是物理学家Philip Taylor。

ex.s: I’m certainly not going to advise my friend or anyone else to invest in quantum computers.
ex.t: 我当然不会建议我的朋友或任何人投资量子计算机。

ex.s: Will Quantum Computers Ever Come into Being?
ex.t: 量子计算机会成为现实吗？

ex.s: When people think about operating systems ____ were developed for the personal computer, Microsoft may come to mind.
ex.t: 当人们想到为个人电脑开发的____操作系统时，可能会想到微软。

ex.s: A computer system will analyze the video to determine whether a cow is sick.
ex.t: 一个计算机系统将分析视频，判断一头牛是否生病。

ex.s: Paulo Magalhaes, a 34-year-old Portuguese computer engineer, loves to open his mailbox and find a brightly colored picture of Rome’s Colosseum.
ex.t: 34岁的葡萄牙计算机工程师保罗·马加良斯喜欢打开邮箱，发现一张色彩鲜艳的罗马斗兽场图片。

ex.s: These days, it is not unusual for 10-to 12-year-olds to publish their own websites or for second and third graders____36____（begin）computer classes.
ex.t: 与此同时，随着各大出版商继续开发面向学龄前儿童的____37____（教育）电脑程序，电脑游戏也越来越受欢迎。

ex.s: At the same time, computer games are becoming increasingly popular as major publishing houses continue to develop____37____（education）computer programs for children in preschool.
ex.t: 此外，技术知识已经成为大多数工作的____38____（要求），因为在日益数字化的世界中，计算机已成为大多数____39____（职业）中的常用工具。

ex.s: Also, technological know-how has become a____38____（require）for most jobs in an increasingly digital world, as the computer has become a common tool in most____39____（profession）
ex.t: 此外，在一个日益数字化的世界里，技术知识已成为大多数工作的___38___（require），因为计算机已成为大多数___39___（profession）中的常用工具。

ex.s: We were raised on books and computers, highways and cell phones, but now we were living in a village without running water or electricity It was easy for us to go to sleep at the end of the day feeling a little misunderstood.
ex.t: 我们是在书本、电脑、高速公路和手机的环境中长大的，但现在却住在一个没有自来水和电的村庄。一天结束时，我们带着一点不被理解的感觉入睡是很容易的事。

ex.s: I can, from my computer at home, pull up satellite images of Juan’s village.
ex.t: 在我们的社会中，我们知道地球只有一个月亮。

ex.s: Buying a computer             B.
ex.t: 买一台电脑          B.

ex.s: When we turn on a light or switch on a TV or a computer we use energy and we need water to produce this energy.
ex.t: 当我们开灯或打开电视、电脑时，我们消耗能源，而生产这些能源需要水。

ex.s: To help students demonstrate their computer skills.
ex.t: 帮助学生展示他们的计算机技能。

ex.s: As a shy person, working from home, hiding behind my computer was brilliant.
ex.t: 作为一个害羞的人，在家工作、躲在电脑后面棒极了。

ex.s: In library bocks and computers, you can find information on starting a business.
ex.t: 在图书馆的书籍和电脑里，你可以找到创业的信息。

ex.s: Examples and dialogues are recorded with real native speakers instead of automatic computers.
ex.t: 该应用让我们的实用语言课程随时随地可用。

ex.s: Thus, the keyboard can determine people's identities, and by extension, whether they should be given access to the computer it's connected to—regardless of whether someone gets the password right.
ex.t: 因此，键盘可以确定人们的身份，进而判断是否应允许他们使用与其连接的电脑——无论某人是否输入了正确的密码。

ex.s: Computers are much easier to operate.
ex.t: 电脑操作更容易了。

ex.s: All participants must address how communication or transportation technology has promoted the quality of life for Americans throughout history． To many people，technology means computers， hand﹣held devices， or vehicles that travel to distant planets． However， technology is also the application of scientific knowledge to solve a problem， touching lives in countless ways．
ex.t: 所有参与者都必须阐述通信或交通技术如何在整个历史中提升了美国人的生活品质。对许多人来说，技术意味着计算机、手持设备或驶向遥远行星的交通工具。然而，技术也是应用科学知识解决问题，以无数方式触动生活。

ex.s: Documentary： A visual presentation （such as a video， slide show， or computer project） no more than 10 minutes long． A desktop computer， screen， projector， and loudspeakers will be available． Students must provide their presentations on CDs before Friday， March 23．
ex.t: 纪录片：视觉呈现（如视频、幻灯片或电脑作品），时长不超过10分钟。将提供台式电脑、屏幕、投影仪和扬声器。学生必须在3月23日周五前以CD提交作品。

ex.s: B．a desktop computer and a CD
ex.t: B．台式电脑和CD

ex.s: D．a desktop computer and loudspeakers
ex.t: D．台式电脑和扬声器

ex.s: Devices were grouped by generation — Desktop computers, basic mobile phones, and box-set TVs defined 1992.
ex.t: 设备按代分类——台式电脑、基本功能手机和套装电视定义了1992年。

ex.s: They found that more on-demand entertainment viewing on tablets instead of TVs and desktop computers could cut energy consumption by 44%.
ex.t: 他们发现，更多在平板电脑上而不是电视和台式电脑上进行按需娱乐观看可以将能耗降低44%。

ex.s: The desktop computer.
ex.t: 台式电脑。

ex.s: A computer analysis blindly compared calls produced by mothers and chicks, ranking them by similarity.
ex.t: 计算机分析在不知情的情况下比较了母亲和幼鸟发出的叫声，并按相似度排序。

ex.s: The possibility of entering into and losing such a match should concentrate the minds of computer scientists.
ex.t: 陷入并输掉这样一局棋的可能性，理应让计算机科学家集中注意力。

ex.s: English was invented by people, not computers, and it reflects the creativity of the human race.
ex.t: 英语是人类而非计算机发明的，它反映了人类的创造力。

ex.s: We could also say English was created by people, not by computers, so it does not follow strict rules.
ex.t: 我们也可以说英语是由人创造的，而不是由电脑创造的，所以它不遵守严格的规则。

ex.s: Don't play computer games too much.
ex.t: 不要玩太多电脑游戏。

ex.s: As a computer engineer, there' s always a new challenge just around the corner!
ex.t: 作为一名计算机工程师，新的挑战总是近在眼前！

ex.s: Unlike the original stories, it is set in modern times and features modern technologies such as computers and smart phones.
ex.t: 与最初的故事不同，它以现代为背景，以电脑和智能手机等现代技术为特色。
